personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every area, collect all 5 coins, gems, relics, keys and hearts, open every locked door and finish the level with the exit.
personas.style: Methodical: uses goto:x,y to reach each item, checks coins/keys counters after every pickup, then walks to the exit and clicks through Level complete, Finish and Play again.

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit or important outcomes early or by unintended routes: dash past gates and doors, cross spikes and enemies, use the lever out of order, skip keys.
personas.style: Aggressive: prefers dash-* tokens and diagonal-looking inputs, tries bumping into closed gates and locked doors without keys, dashes into walls, and tries to reach the exit before collecting the keys it needs.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break timing: pause, unpause, restart, quit and press several keys in one tick during pickups, hits, timer expiry and level completion.
personas.style: Spams input: uses a+b combos such as pause+left, use+down, dash-right+esc, enter during dialogs, click:btn-resume while playing, and repeated restart clicks, checking state after every single tick.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document one sentence at a time and check each sentence literally, e.g. one move per tick, dash recharge shows Dash 5, invulnerability lasts 4 ticks after respawn, heart at 5 lives gives 500 points.
personas.style: Slow and literal: performs one documented action, compares every stated number against state and HUD, and notes any sentence the build contradicts.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Drive score, lives, timer, coins and keys toward their limits and verify every amount: score floor 0 and cap 999999, lives 0..5, timer 300 reset, spike cost 500, time bonus 10 per tick.
personas.style: Numeric: collects hearts at 5 lives, lets the timer run out, hits spikes at low score and at 1 life, restarts repeatedly, and compares HUD numbers with state fields on each tick.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause, game over, level complete, victory) and verify what is shown, which buttons exist, that each visible button is on top and clickable, and that nothing is shown in the wrong mode.
personas.style: Observational: after each mode change reads the ui list, checks dialog text and button visibility and top flags, clicks every visible button at least once, and confirms that no dialog or button appears during normal play.

checks.rule: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
Lives stay between 0 and the maximum of 5.
At 0 lives the game is over (gameover mode with the Game over dialog).
A life is lost one at a time (touching an enemy or spikes costs one life); only a restart resets lives in bulk.
The timer is between 0 and 300.
When the timer reaches 0 you lose a life and the timer resets to 300.
While paused nothing moves: player, enemies, timer, dash recharge are frozen.
checks.expect: cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && cur.state.enemies == prev.state.enemies

checks.rule: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens in that tick.
checks.expect: cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.coins == prev.state.coins && cur.state.keys == prev.state.keys

checks.rule: The pause menu (Resume) is shown only while paused.
Paused mode shows the pause menu with Resume and Restart level buttons.
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-resume' && u.visible) && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-restart' && u.visible)

checks.rule: The player makes at most one move (a step or a dash) per tick; a dash moves at most two tiles in a straight line.
checks.expect: (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y) && abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2 && (includes(cur.token, 'dash') || abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 1)

checks.rule: Walls, locked doors and closed gates are solid: the player never stands on them.
checks.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != 'D' && !(tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) == '=' && !cur.state.gateOpen)

checks.rule: Enemies move one tile every other tick, so at most one tile per tick.
checks.expect: all(cur.state.enemies, e => abs(e.x - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).x) + abs(e.y - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).y) <= 1)

checks.rule: A dash sets the recharge to 6 and it counts down at the end of the running tick, so right after a dash it shows 5.
The dash recharge counts down by 1 per running tick and never goes below 0.
The HUD shows Dash ready at 0 and Dash n otherwise, with n the ticks until ready.
The HUD always shows the current score.
The HUD always shows the current lives.
The HUD always shows the current keys, coins n/5 and time left.
checks.expect: num(cur.hud.keys) == cur.state.keys && num(cur.hud.coins) == cur.state.coins && num(cur.hud.time) == cur.state.timeLeft

checks.rule: The level has exactly 5 coins; coins collected never exceed 5.
Items disappear when collected and never come back except on restart: coin count never drops outside a restart.
Walking into a locked door with a key opens it and uses exactly one key; keys never go negative.
use on a lever toggles every gate; use on any other tile does not change the gates.
checks.when: includes(cur.token, 'use') && prev.state.mode == 'playing' && cur.state.mode == 'playing' && !includes(cur.state.events, 'restart') && tile(prev, prev.state.player.x, prev.state.player.y) == 'L'

checks.rule: After respawn enemies cannot hurt you for 4 ticks; invulnerable counts those ticks down from 4 to 0.
After losing a life you reappear at (1, 1).
Restart level puts the whole level back to its start: score 0, 3 lives, keys 0, coins 0, running straight away.
Stepping on the exit shows the Level complete dialog with a Finish button; the mode is complete only while that dialog is open.
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'dialog' && u.visible && includes(u.text, 'Level complete')) && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-next' && u.visible)

checks.rule: Completing the level adds a time bonus of 10 points per tick left on the timer.
Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.

value.notes: Round 1, literal newcomer pass. No prior coverage, so start with the simplest documented sentences and check each number against state and HUD after every tick. Checks to make: one move per tick when two movement keys are pressed; dash shows "Dash 5" right after a dash and counts to "Dash ready" after 6 running ticks; pause freezes timer, dash recharge and toasts; Resume via Enter or click continues in place. Note any sentence the build contradicts. Not yet observed: map layout, enemy timing, any dialog.

value.notes: Round 2 notes. Seed 4242 shows a likely score bug: spikes at tick 16 took score from 100 to 65136 (about 65536 - 400, a wrap), where the design says score floors at 0. Seed 4242 tick 10: a dash-down picked up a key, got hit and respawned in one tick, but HUD Keys stayed 0; this may break the keep-keys-after-respawn rule. Seed 12345 map: key at (4,5); locked door D at (10,6) is the only way into the exit area (E at (12,7)); lever L at (1,8) opens gate (8,3). Dashes so far never passed solid tiles. Seed 777: lever use at (6,1)/(7,2) did not toggle the gate; check that use on the lever toggles gateOpen. Pause plus move in one tick froze the world as designed. Hidden buttons did nothing, as designed. Next: confirm the score wrap minimally, then test lever toggling and key-then-respawn.

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stale after dash collects a coin
verdicts.observed: After dash-right at tick 7 the state reports coins=2 (score 200), but the HUD still shows 'Coins 1/5'. Keys and time HUD match the state.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so after collecting the second coin it should read 'Coins 2/5'.

verdicts.title: Movement applied in the same tick as pause
verdicts.observed: Token 'pause+right' pauses the game and the player still moves from (1,1) to (2,1) in that tick (event 'move' logged alongside 'pause').
verdicts.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player should remain at (1,1).

verdicts.title: Pause-freeze violation at restart click is a false positive
verdicts.observed: The flagged tick is the 'click:btn-restart' tick, where the timer resets from 299 to 300. This is a legitimate restart reset, which the check does not exempt. The same-tick move during 'pause+left' is the separate pause-input bug covered by candidate 1.
verdicts.expected: Restart is allowed to reset the timer and state, so the freeze check should exclude restart events.

verdicts.title: Restart leaves the game paused with the pause menu gone
verdicts.observed: After 'click:btn-restart' from the pause menu, the state is still mode=paused with no dialog or buttons listed (events=[restart]). The restart-resets check also fails because mode is 'paused' rather than 'playing'.
verdicts.expected: Restart Level resets the level and the game is running again straight away (mode playing, no pause menu).

verdicts.title: Game stuck paused with no visible menu after restart
verdicts.observed: After pause then click:btn-restart, the game remains paused with no dialog or button shown. Thirty 'wait' ticks change nothing; the timer and world stay frozen.
verdicts.expected: Restart runs the game straight away. The player should not be left in a paused state with no way to act on it.

verdicts.title: Level-complete Finish button covered by bonus banner and toast
verdicts.observed: On the level-complete dialog the 'btn-next' (Finish) button reports top=false; the 'bonus-banner' and a 'Relic!' toast sit on top of it, so a click there would not reach Finish.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover the Finish button in the level-complete dialog.

verdicts.title: Spikes wrap score to 65136, then drive it negative (-300)
verdicts.observed: At tick 3 the player steps on spikes with score 100. Score becomes 65136 (about 100 - 500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit) instead of clamping at 0. A later coin then shows -300 on the HUD and in state, so score goes negative.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points, but the score never goes below 0 (it clamps at 0). Score must stay within 0..999,999 at all times.

verdicts.title: HUD coins counter stale after dash collects a coin
verdicts.observed: After dash-right at tick 1 collects a coin, state reports coins=1 and the HUD score updates to 100, but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD is out of sync with the game state.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' right after the coin is collected.
